text:
pagerduty: PROD-LB-HTTP-ERRORS triggered for prod-api-cluster (high 502/524 rate) - paging primary on-call
incident-bot: paging Mira (@Mira) and escalation to Sam after 2m if unacked :rotating_light:
Mira: acked. I'm on it, looking at LB metrics now. any customer reports?
Carla: support sees spike in customer errors, ~15% of sessions 502s, some TLS handshake failures reported via logs.
Mira: thanks. checking ALB target health and cert status. sam, alex FYI - might need infra assistance if cert or backend nodes are unhealthy.
Alex: I'm looking at the autoscaling group instances and backend logs. no obvious CPU/oom. tails show repeated `SSL alert 40` in front of some connections.
Sam: I'll pull ALB target health.
Sam: ALB console -> targets: 3 healthy, 2 unhealthy in prod-api-asg-2. unhealthy have `HTTP 502` from target checks.
Mira: can you curl the backends directly? `curl -v https://10.20.5.12/health`
Alex: `curl` to unhealthy target returns `empty response` then TLS handshake error: `SSL_connect returned=1 errno=0 state=error: certificate verify failed` — weird, cert looks expired on that instance.
Carla: support forwarded one customer stack trace that includes `tls: handshake failure` + SNI shows `api.redwood-inference.com`.
Mira: check instance certs: `sudo ls /etc/ssl/certs && openssl x509 -noout -dates -in /etc/ssl/certs/prod_api.pem`
Alex: confirmed two instances have an old cert (expires 2024-09-01). We rolled a cert rotation last night but apparently 2 instances didn't pick up the new cert.
Sam: why didn't rotation land? ASG lifecycle hooks? I see bake jobs succeeded. config agent failed on those two hosts: `cert-agent: restart failed (exit code 1)`.
Mira: ok root cause seems to be partial config-agent failure during rotation -> old cert still served causing client TLS fallback to fail and ALB health checks to 502. We should mark targets draining and replace nodes.
incident-bot: Escalation to on-call infra (Sam) at +10m as per policy.
Sam: I'm initiating rolling restart for the two affected instances via console -> `terminate-instances` to force ASG replacement. Also toggling target group to `drain` on those instances to avoid 502s.
Alex: initiating a fast redeploy of cert-agent with extra logging to prevent repeat. pushing hotfix to image pipeline now.
Carla: customer impact note: Support bundle updated. Affected customers: subset of EU customers hitting those AZ nodes - raising P1 notice to ops-notify list.
Mira: mitigation in progress: terminations issued, new instances launching. ALB target health transitioning -> new targets becoming healthy.
Sam: new instances report `prod_api.pem` with correct `NotAfter=2026`. health checks back to 200.
Mira: initial rollback hypothesis resolved. I'll keep page open until all targets healthy and error rate back to baseline. ETA 8-12m.
Carla: posting interim customer status: "Some customers experienced transient TLS and 502 errors; engineering is mitigating and estimating full recovery in ~10 minutes."
pagerduty: alert acknowledged by Mira at 1845302480.
incident-bot: annotate incident timeline: pagerduty fired -> ack -> infra escalated -> partial rotation failure -> node replacement -> cert fix deployed.
Mira: postmortem notes to capture: (1) cert-agent should have retry/backoff + alert on failed rotations, (2) ASG termination should trigger immediate post-launch config validation, (3) reduce cert TTL window for faster rollback options.
Sam: will open a follow-up ticket with logs: `cert-agent.log` snippets and ASG lifecycle events. linking to incident doc after clean-up.
Alex: pushing a small healthcheck change to make TLS check more explicit so ALB can failover quicker.
Mira: all clear from my side — last error spike resolved, customers seeing normal traffic. closing page in 5m if stable. :white_check_mark:
Carla: thanks team, I'll update customer incident message and escalate to account teams for any follow-ups.
Mira: thanks. wrapping up and handing off to Sam for post-incident actions.
Sam: got it, will own the follow-ups.
incident-bot: thread closed for active paging at 1845302805.
